title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: An adult lying prone, from directly above the right buttock and back of the right thigh: head off the top, feet off the bottom, the patient's right on the image right; natal cleft at the left, lateral hip at the right.
teachingPoint: The curved probe lies transverse just below the gluteal fold, midway between the ischial tuberosity and the greater trochanter; the needle enters at its lateral end.
claims: Curved probe transverse just below the gluteal fold, midway between the ischial tuberosity and the greater trochanter (record: curvilinear transducer; transverse below the gluteal fold; landmarks).
Needle in-plane from the lateral end, aimed medially (record: in-plane; NYSORA: lateral to medial).
Labels: Gluteal fold, Greater trochanter, Curved probe, Block needle.
